title: 第19章 陆成发誓墨尘居心灰意冷第20章 彻底失望凌雪瑶的计策
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
陆成微微一愣，他本以为王厉出现，王飞宇品性那么差，那他的爷爷自然也是一丘之鹤。
他以为王厉会与墨尘居撕破脸，开始发难，伺机对他出手。
但让他震惊的是，王厉听完真相后，反而没有护短，而是直接给了王飞宇一巴掌，并斥责对方。
这倒让陆成非常意外，看来王厉与墨尘居往日私下里倒是关系不错，亦还是王厉人性使然，这一点陆成接触甚少，不得而知。
但他心里总有种很怪的感觉，王厉虽在斥责王飞宇，但他那句谁教你那么做的，反而倒像是他相信自己孙子仿佛是受人主使，才这般做，这种溺爱，有点病态了！
还有王厉看他的眼神，太过平静了，平静得让他心里感到不安！
围观的众人也是纷纷一愣，没想到往日里极其护短的王厉，此刻竟突然翻脸，一改常态般当场教训起王飞宇，倒是让他们目瞪口呆，一脸懵逼，甚至不少人暗中揣测王厉是否真心，还是演戏给众人看。
本着看好戏的何念慈和吴长风也是目光一凝，脸上露出更加怪异的表情。
王飞宇扑通一声跪在地上，不只是因为剧痛还是王厉的斥责，眼泪瞬间掉了下来，开口道：“爷爷，都是……”
“住口！！”王厉直接打断了他，低吼道：“回去给老子待在屋里，一年不准出门！”
说着，他似是不解气，再度抬起手想要扇去。
凌雪瑶似乎也没想到王厉到此竟突然教训起王飞宇来，美眸也是微微一愣，接着又看到王厉再次抬手扇向王飞宇时，她连忙开口道：“王师叔，手下留情！”
墨尘居也是突然开口劝阻道：“王师兄，罢了，老夫不记仇，只是你孙儿方才确实是有点过分了。”
王厉这才停下手来，然后又怼了王飞宇两句，转身目光扫向陆成，又深深地看了一眼陆成后，便看向墨尘居，道：“令孙给墨大师造成这等麻烦，老夫心里愧疚，我替我孙子给你赔个不是。”
墨尘居脸色也是逐渐舒展开来，笑道：“王长老言重了，回头好好管教一番便是。”
王厉身后，王飞宇的右脸早已高高红肿了起来，因鼻梁骨断裂塌陷，看起来极为的吓人，他抚摸着右脸，脸上露出痛苦扭曲的表情，他目光看向众人，不少人看向他的眼神虽然平静，但在他看来就是赤裸裸的嘲讽与羞辱。
他不懂，他捏碎传音石，是让他爷爷来给他撑场子，一举诛杀陆成的。
但此刻他爷爷前来，反而并没有像往日般溺爱他，反而当众扇他的脸，还斥责他！
还不给他解释的机会，他还被罚一年不能出门！
他的胸口剧烈起伏着，浑身都在剧烈颤抖，接着他望着陆成，双目闪过一丝毒蛇般的阴森，接着又涌出无尽滔天杀意！

陆成心中的怪异感愈加强烈，王厉虽是教训王飞宇，但后一句斥责询问王飞宇是谁教他这么做，但是他并未给王飞宇解释的机会，而是直接打断了对方，这就有点耐人寻味了！
这时，陆成感到杀意向他传来，他很快就锁定了杀意来源，在此刻这个局面下，能对他有如此强烈杀意的只有一个人，那就是王飞宇。
他转头望向王飞宇，嘴角微微勾起一丝笑容，气得王飞宇脸都绿了。
王厉转头狠狠瞪了一眼王飞宇，王飞宇噤若寒蝉，面露惶恐之色。
王厉看向墨尘居，道：“我回去一定好好严加管教这个逆孙！”说着，他目光看向陆成，上下打量着，眼中闪过惊讶，笑道：“你这徒儿不错，从我来至此，神情一直镇定自若，目光锐利，虽看穿着来自杂役峰，但看这气势，一看就有你当年的那股子风范啊，呵呵呵……”
被王厉这般夸赞，虽不明白他言外之意，但陆成该有的礼数还得有，毕竟对方除了王飞宇的爷爷之外，还是青玄宗内门长老，最起码现在对他没有产生任何危机，至少此刻明面上确实是如此。
陆成恭敬道：“见过王长老，多谢长老夸赞。”
王厉微微点头，墨尘居见陆成如此，脸上也露出笑容，陆成这副谦虚有礼，令他心情大好，心中再次确信自己没有选错人。
凌雪瑶也是目光上下打量着陆成，同时她的美眸内也闪过一丝错愕，陆成的声音，同样让她有股莫名的熟悉感，她眨眨眼想了很久，也一时想不起来。
场面一度变得和谐下来。
凌雪瑶只能暂时先放下心中的疑惑，她美眸看向墨尘居和王厉，陡然开口道：“诸位师叔，师兄师姐，既然此矛盾已化解，不如我们现在就开始一品炼丹师考核吧？”
content_en:
Lu Cheng was slightly startled. He originally thought that Wang Li would show up. Since Wang Feiyu's character was so bad, his grandfather would naturally be the same as him.
He thought that Wang Li would break up with Mo Chenju and started to get angry, waiting for an opportunity to take action against him.
But what shocked him was that after Wang Li heard the truth, he didn't defend himself. Instead, he slapped Wang Feiyu and scolded him.
This made Lu Cheng very surprised. It seemed that Wang Li and Mo Chenju had a good relationship in private in the past. It was also due to Wang Li's human nature. Lu Cheng had little contact with them, so he didn't know.
But he always had a strange feeling in his heart. Although Wang Li was scolding Wang Feiyu, his words about "who taught you to do that" actually seemed like he believed that his grandson was being instigated by others to do what he did. This kind of doting was a bit sick!
And the way Wang Li looked at him was so calm, so calm that it made him feel uneasy!
The onlookers were also stunned. Unexpectedly, Wang Li, who used to be very protective of his shortcomings, suddenly turned against him at this moment. He changed his mind and taught Wang Feiyu a lesson on the spot. They were stunned and confused. Many people even secretly speculated whether Wang Li was sincere or was just acting for everyone to see.
He Nianci and Wu Changfeng, who were watching the show, also stared at each other with even weirder expressions on their faces.
Wang Feiyu knelt on the ground with a plop, not only because of the severe pain but also Wang Li's reprimand, tears fell instantly, and he said: "Grandpa, it's all..."
"Shut up!!" Wang Li interrupted him directly and shouted: "Go back and stay in the house with me. You are not allowed to go out for a year!"
As he said this, he seemed upset and raised his hand again to slap away.
Ling Xueyao didn't seem to expect that Wang Li would suddenly teach Wang Feiyu a lesson, and her beautiful eyes were slightly stunned. Then when she saw Wang Li raising his hand to slap Wang Feiyu again, she quickly said: "Uncle Wang, please be merciful!"
Mo Chenju also suddenly spoke to dissuade him: "Senior Brother Wang, that's all, I don't hold grudges, but your grandson just went too far."
Only then did Wang Li stop, and then slandered Wang Feiyu. He turned around and glanced at Lu Cheng. After another deep look at Lu Cheng, he looked at Mo Chenju and said, "I feel guilty that your grandson has caused such trouble to Master Mo. I will make amends to you on my grandson's behalf."
Mo Chenju's face gradually relaxed, and he smiled and said: "Elder Wang's words are serious, just turn around and discipline him properly."
Behind Wang Li, the right side of Wang Feiyu's face was already highly red and swollen. The bridge of his nose was broken and collapsed, and he looked extremely scary. He stroked his right side of his face, with a painful and twisted expression on his face. He looked at everyone. Although many people looked at him calmly, in his opinion, it was naked ridicule and humiliation.
He didn't understand. He crushed the sound transmission stone to ask his grandfather to support him and kill Lu Cheng in one fell swoop.
But now his grandfather came, but instead of doting on him as before, he slapped his face in public and scolded him!
Without giving him a chance to explain, he was fined and couldn't leave the house for a year!
His chest was heaving violently, and his whole body was shaking violently. Then he looked at Lu Cheng, his eyes flashed with a sinister look like a poisonous snake, and then endless killing intent surged out!
The strange feeling in Lu Cheng's heart became more and more intense. Although Wang Li taught Wang Feiyu a lesson, he reprimanded and asked Wang Feiyu who taught him to do this, but he did not give Wang Feiyu a chance to explain, but directly interrupted him. This is a bit intriguing!
At this time, Lu Cheng felt murderous intent coming toward him, and he quickly located the source of the murderous intent. In this situation, there was only one person who could have such strong murderous intent against him, and that was Wang Feiyu.
He turned to look at Wang Feiyu, with a slight smile on his lips, which made Wang Feiyu's face turn green with anger.
Wang Li turned around and glared at Wang Feiyu fiercely. Wang Feiyu remained silent with a look of fear on his face.
Wang Li looked at Mo Chenju and said, "I will discipline him well when I go back."This rebellious grandson! "As he spoke, he looked at Lu Cheng, looked up and down, surprise flashed in his eyes, and said with a smile: "You are a good disciple. Since I came here, your expression has always been calm and composed, and your eyes are sharp. Although you look like you are from the Yiyong Peak, but looking at this aura, you can see the same demeanor you had back then, hehehe..."
Being praised like this by Wang Li, although he didn't understand what he meant, Lu Cheng still had to be polite. After all, in addition to Wang Feiyu's grandfather, he was also an elder of the inner sect of Qingxuan Sect. At least there was no crisis for him now, at least that was the case on the surface at this moment.
Lu Cheng said respectfully: "I have met Elder Wang, thank you very much for the compliment. "
Wang Li nodded slightly. When Mo Chenju saw Lu Cheng like this, a smile appeared on his face. Lu Cheng's humility and courtesy made him feel good, and he was once again convinced that he had not chosen the wrong person.
Ling Xueyao also looked Lu Cheng up and down, and at the same time, a trace of astonishment flashed in her beautiful eyes. Lu Cheng's voice also made her feel inexplicably familiar. She blinked and thought about it for a long time, but she couldn't remember it for a while.
The scene became harmonious for a time.
Ling Xueyao could only put aside the doubts in her heart for the time being. She looked at Mo Chenju and Wang Li with her beautiful eyes, and suddenly said: "Uncles, brothers and sisters, since this conflict has been resolved, why don't we start the first-grade alchemist assessment now? "
